main_issue: Whether and how Agent D's wake setup at the void deck can be arranged to accommodate A's wheelchair access, B's sleep, and C's morning exercise spot

A-B.evidence: A and B never address each other; both raise separate concerns and both end up accepting D's accommodations (turns 25, 28, 23).

A-C.evidence: No direct exchange; both raised concerns separately and both accept D's arrangement at the end (turns 19-25).

A-D.evidence: D offers to shift the tent (turn 2); A confirms 'Yes, that's perfect' (turn 25) and 'that will be fine' (turn 28).

B-C.evidence: B proposes moving to C's playground spot (turn 11); C says it works for evenings but not for 7 a.m. (turn 14); later both are satisfied with the compromise (turns 19, 23).

B-D.evidence: D refuses to stop the chanting (turn 5) and rejects B's move (turn 12); B concedes (turn 16) and D agrees to point speakers away (turn 17); B thanks D (turn 23).

C-D.evidence: D agrees with C's objection to moving every day (turn 15); C offers to shift exercise to 6:30 (turn 19); D thanks C (turn 20).
